content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Installing and Setting Up Python Environment
    - Lesson 2: Understanding Data Types and Variables in Python
    - Lesson 3: Reading and Writing CSV Files in Python
    - Lesson 4: Basic Data Manipulation with Pandas
    - Lesson 5: Exploring Data Using Descriptive Statistics
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Data Visualization with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 7: Creating Line Charts and Scatter Plots
    - Lesson 8: Grouped Bar Plots and Heatmaps
    - Lesson 9: Data Cleaning Techniques with Pandas
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Data Exploration using Seaborn Library

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Creating, Altering and Deleting Tables
    - Lesson 3: Understanding Joins (INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN)
    - Lesson 4: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 5: WHERE Clauses and Conditional Expressions
    - Lesson 6: Sorting Results with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 7: GROUP BY Clause for Aggregations
    - Lesson 8: HAVING Clause for Filtering Aggregate Data
    - Lesson 9: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to SQL Functions (COUNT(), AVG(), MAX(), MIN(), SUM())

   Track: Intermediate SQL
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Joins (CROSS JOIN, OUTER APPLY)
    - Lesson 2: Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER(), RANK(), DENSE_RANK(), LAG())
    - Lesson 3: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and Recursive Queries
    - Lesson 4: Using CASE Statements for Conditional Operations
    - Lesson 5: Data Modification with SQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 6: Working with Dates and Time in SQL
    - Lesson 7: Indexing and Optimizing SQL Queries
    - Lesson 8: Database Normalization Concepts
    - Lesson 9: Introduction to SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) or MySQL Workbench
    - Lesson 10: Real-world Case Studies Using SQL

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Data
    - Lesson 2: Removing Duplicates from Data
    - Lesson 3: Data Normalization Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Outlier Detection and Handling
    - Lesson 5: Feature Engineering for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Text Preprocessing and Natural Language Processing (NLP) Basics
    - Lesson 7: Working with Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to scikit-learn Library for Data Preprocessing
    - Lesson 9: Feature Scaling Techniques for Machine Learning Models
    - Lesson 10: Case Studies on Real-world Data Cleaning Challenges

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
    - Lesson 1: EDA Best Practices and Workflow
    - Lesson 2: Creating Summary Statistics Reports
    - Lesson 3: Visualizing Distributions with Histograms and Boxplots
    - Lesson 4: Exploring Correlations Between Variables
    - Lesson 5: Clustering Techniques for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Time Series Analysis Basics
    - Lesson 7: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Dimensionality Reduction
    - Lesson 8: Association Rule Learning (Market Basket Analysis)
    - Lesson 9: Text Mining and Topic Modeling with Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA)
    - Lesson 10: Real-world Case Studies Using EDA Techniques
